XPTN-9000 Aestra Series Industrial Switch
一
Highway Network Solut
In an intelligent highway network system, the stable operation of video surveillance, emergency telephones, and traffic
information systems is crucial for ensuring road safety, so the tolerance for network outages is almost zero. The specific service
requirements are as follows: Road surveillance cameras need to collect images in real time, complete rapid license plate recognition
and capture, and transmit massive video and image data to remote data centers; emergency telephones in tunnels need to operate
24/7 to respond to unexpected accidents. All these services rely on high-performance network devices to handle high-density data
transmission requirements.
The Scodeno Aestra Series XPTN-9000-Bypass Industrial Switch provides strong support for intelligent highway networks
through innovative technologies and reliable designs. The specific advantages of the solution are as follows:
1. Dual Redundant Network Architecture for Zero-Outage Guarantee
1. Integrated hardware-level bypass function: When the device malfunctions, it can automatically maintain physical straight-
through of the link. Even if the switch power is disconnected, the bypass mode is activated immediately, ensuring uninterrupted
data transmission on the physical link and preventing services such as video backhaul and emergency calls from being affected.
2. Compatibility with G.8032 standard ERPS ring network protocol: The fault self-healing time is less than 20ms, which, together
with the hardware-level bypass function, forms a dual guarantee. This minimizes the risk of network outages and ensures the
continuous operation of critical highway services.

XPTN-9000-X-Blue Series Industrial Switch
Network Solution
In photovoltaic power generation systems, precise solar tracking control relies on highly reliable network infrastructure
for real-time dynamic optimization to maximize power generation efficiency. The system uses light (radiation) sensors to
monitor the sun's position in real time. Captured solar irradiance data is transmitted to the control system, which analyzes
the data, calculates the optimal angle for the solar panels, and sends commands to the PLC to drive the panel's motor for
angle adjustment, ensuring the panels remain oriented toward the sun. To guarantee optimal positioning, the system
continuously acquires new sensor data and adjusts panel orientation in real time, forming a closed-loop control system.
The critical network component enabling this process is the industrial Ethernet switch.
The Scodeno XPTN-9000-X-Blue Series Industrial Ethernet Switch provides a highly reliable ERPS (Ethernet Ring Protection
Switching) ring redundancy architecture in this system. With robust environmental resilience, high bandwidth, and low-latency
data transmission, it meets the stringent requirements of solar tracking systems for precise panel positioning.
